settings.title: Format Tools Settings
setting.builtinFunctionsUpper: Built-in functions in upper case (NVL, SUBSTR, ...)
setting.endWithName: END with the name of the subprogram or package (END name;)
setting.executeImmediateLiteralOnOwnLine: Long EXECUTE IMMEDIATE literal on its own line
setting.blankLineBeforeSubprograms: Blank line before each PROCEDURE and FUNCTION
setting.blankLineAfterPackageHeader: Blank line after the package header (before the first PROCEDURE or FUNCTION)
setting.noBlankLineBeforePackageEnd: Remove blank lines before the closing END of a package
preview.title: Preview
setting.alignDeclarations: Align declarations in groups (names and types)
setting.indentComments: Indent comments like the code they belong to
setting.headerTailsOnOneLine: RESULT_CACHE, AUTHID ... and IS on the line of the subprogram header
setting.insertLayout: INSERT: columns and VALUES in parentheses on their own lines
setting.selectIntoOnOneLine: SELECT ... INTO: short lists on one line
setting.updateSetLayout: UPDATE: SET with the first assignment, = aligned
setting.joinOnAlignment: JOIN: ON and AND aligned to the JOIN keyword
setting.subqueryLayout: Subquery in parentheses on one line when it fits
setting.alignAliases: SELECT: align the aliases in one column
setting.spaceAfterComma: Blank after each comma: NVL(1,0) -> NVL(1, 0)
setting.wrapLongLines: Wrap lines longer than the right margin
setting.joinIfConditions: IF conditions on one logical line (wrapped at AND/OR)
setting.shortParenGroupOnOneLine: Short parenthesised condition on one line
settings.imported: Rules read from the file, settings set:
settings.fileError: Could not read or write the file
setting.assignmentSingleSpace: := with one blank on each side, not aligned
setting.tightUnaryMinus: Unary minus without a blank: IN (-4068, -4061)
setting.oneSpaceBeforeComment: One blank before a comment at the end of a line
setting.caseLayout: CASE: short on one line, long with WHEN / ELSE under CASE
setting.typeFieldsLayout: RECORD / OBJECT: fields under the header, ) on its own line
setting.selectListFill: SELECT and INTO lists filled up to the right margin
setting.tableAliasSingleSpace: FROM / JOIN: one blank before the table alias
setting.bulkCollectOnOneLine: BULK COLLECT INTO on one line
setting.jsonArrayaggLayout: JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT(: object on the next line, FORMAT JSON after its value
setting.jsonTableLayout: JSON_TABLE: COLUMNS under the first argument, one column per line
setting.conditionPerLine: Long condition: one per line, AND / OR first, THEN on its own line
setting.fillLiteralArguments: Call of literals only: fill up to the right margin
setting.wrapInLists: Long IN (...) list: break like an argument list
setting.keepShortArguments: Short arguments stay on one line up to 120 characters
setting.wrapArithmetic: Long a + b - c: break after the operator
setting.noBlankAtBlockEdges: No blank line after BEGIN / THEN / LOOP and before END / ELSE / EXCEPTION
setting.lowerCapitalNames: Names written in capitals in lower case (ACCOUNT -> account)
setting.upperContextKeywords: ROWNUM, NO_DATA_FOUND, JSON_TABLE words and DBMS_ / UTL_ packages in upper case
